meta.title: Compresso — Compress Images Online Free | Private, No Upload
meta.description: Free private image compressor. Resize and convert HEIC, JPEG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF on your device. Nothing is uploaded. Works offline as a PWA.
meta.ogTitle: Compresso — private image compression in your browser
meta.ogDescription: Compress photos on your device. 0 bytes uploaded. HEIC support, batch processing, works offline.
